messages:
liz_dev: heads up — planning a bake window for the new matmul kernel + quant bundle tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC. will need drain on a small subset of hosts first.

sam_ops: ack. what's the canary slice?

jordan_runtime: target 2% of inference traffic in region-us-west1 for 15m, then 10% for 30m if stable. fallback policy -> automatic route to legacy kernel.

maria_release: add a note to release notes about quantization ABI change and how to pin model variants. customers on Dedicated who pinned kernel X will be unaffected.

kevin_sre: flag: thermal autoscaling has been flakey on p4d yesterday, recommend narrower host selection for bake to avoid noise.

liz_dev: good call. sam, can you set `deploy-bot` to pick only hosts with tag:stable-thermal=true? example command: `deploy-bot plan --slice 2% --hosts-tag stable-thermal=true --timeout 15m`

sam_ops: doing it now. deploy-bot queueing plan...

deploy-bot: [INFO] queued rollout plan id=rb-2024-1749912345. slice=2%, hosts_tag=stable-thermal=true, preflight_checks=enabled. ETA start=1749918000.

jordan_runtime: preflight smoke checklist:
- `kv-cache` eviction baseline <= 0.5%
- median p95 latency delta <= +12ms
- model output hash regression test pass on 50 prompts

liz_dev: adding rollback criteria: any of:
- error rate spike > 0.5% absolute
- tail latency (99th) > 200ms for more than 2 consecutive minutes
- progressive throughput drop > 8% sustained 5min

maria_release: also capture customer-facing blurb: "Minor kernel update improving matmul throughput. No API changes. If you rely on pinned kernel images, no action required. See docs for pin TTL config."

sam_ops: preflight passed locally. deploy-bot ready to start the 2% canary at window. starting drain plan to rotate 20 hosts out of 800 slowly.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] starting drain phase. draining hosts batch=5 interval=60s. live traffic slice held at 2%.

kevin_sre: watching telemetry — KV cache miss is flat, p95 +5ms so far. looks healthy.

jordan_runtime: run the sample eval set (50 prompts) now, please.

sam_ops: ran eval, 50/50 pass. diffs are non-deterministic token order only.

liz_dev: start ramp to 10% after the 15m canary completes, if no alerts. schedule hold for 5m after ramp.

deploy-bot: [INFO] canary complete. no critical alerts. initiating ramp to 10% (gradual over 10m).

kevin_sre: first 3m of ramp look good. a couple of noisy hosts had +25ms p95 — pulled and reprovisioning.

jordan_runtime: putting a precautionary pin with TTL: set model-serving.pin=rb-1749912345 for 24h so we can roll back to prechange variant quickly.

maria_release: drafting release note now. will announce tomorrow 08:00 UTC to customers.

liz_dev: final checklist before closing window: confirm metrics retention for this rollout (logs + traces + eval outputs) saved to `releases/rb-1749912345` and mark build artifacts with `quant-bundle:v3.2.1`.

sam_ops: logs archived, artifacts tagged. closing bake window at 00:27 UTC if no regressions.

deploy-bot: [COMPLETE] rollout id=rb-2024-1749912345 progressed to 10% stable. pins applied: model-serving.pin=rb-1749912345 ttl=86400s.

liz_dev: thanks all — if anything odd pop up, @kevin_sre and @sam_ops are primary. otherwise we'll plan full rollout next maintenance window. :thumbsup:
